identityReview: Matched Sir Peter Joseph Beck, New Zealand founder of Rocket Lab, through company leadership, New Zealand DPMC honour citation and University of Auckland announcement. Wikipedia gives 1976 or 1977; no exact year inferred from age, apprenticeship or school-leaving age. Birth null and birthUnknown true. Not other persons named Peter Beck.
lifeStatusEvidence: November 14, 2026 company announcement quotes founder and CEO Sir Peter Beck thanking the Electron team after the reported 100th launch. Current leadership page confirms founder, president, CEO and board chair.

sourceReview.scope: Training, founding, early rocket development, orbital launch, university appointment, merger listing, honour and latest operational status.
corrections: Birth remains unknown because available identity source gives 1976/1977. Age in historical SEC filings and school-leaving age do not settle a precise year.

Official Rocket Lab biography dates precision-engineering apprenticeship to 1993; Wikipedia gives 1995. Profile explicitly attributes 1993 to company biography and records disagreement, rather than silently claiming cross-source consensus.

University page URL contains August 29 but displayed publication date is September 4, 2019. Profile uses September 2019 appointment announcement. It explicitly says he did not go to university; adjunct aerospace professorship is appointment, not degree or doctorate.

Company founder date is 2006. Official biography dates president/CEO and board tenure within corporate structure to July 2013, and board chair appointment to May 2021. No claim all legal-entity titles began in 2006.

Company and DPMC describe Atea-1 reaching space in 2009. Avoid broad first-in-Southern-Hemisphere claim, which requires qualifications and wider historical comparison. Reaching space is not proof of orbital insertion.

Still Testing first orbital mission was January 21, 2018, distinct from first Electron test flight in 2017. Mission page has inconsistent UTC/local time conversion; profile uses date only, without reproducing the time mismatch.

Vector business combination is a SPAC merger path; company release dated August 25, 2021 says merger completed and trading starts August 25 as RKLB. Timeline uses month, distinguishing from August 20 shareholder approval and ordinary IPO bookbuilding.

2024 DPMC King’s Birthday Honours awards Knight Companion of New Zealand Order of Merit for aerospace, business and education. This is not a UK peerage or university degree. Historical staffing/mission counts in citation are not treated as current.

November 9, 2026 results target first Neutron launch no earlier than 2027. Backlog and contracts do not prove flights completed; positive GAAP operating cash flow is not equivalent to net profit. Pending acquisition language is not a completed acquisition.

November 14 company release reports successful 100th Electron launch. Count of total launches is not 100 consecutive successes or 100% lifetime success rate. Its iQPS-specific success rate is not extended to all missions. Comparative fastest-ever promotional ranking omitted.
Rocket and spacecraft development credited to teams and partners. Beck is not an astronaut merely because his company launches rockets; no personal spaceflight implied.
sourceReview.limits: AI authored and reviewed, not human/native-language certified. Company mission and financial statements reviewed, not independent launch telemetry or full financial audit. Forecasts remain forecasts.
